analysis: The code snippet calls Integer.parseInt(id) inside an if statement that checks if id is not null. This avoids a NullPointerException, but NumberFormatException is still possible if id is a non-null string that does not represent a valid integer (e.g., contains non-digit characters, is empty, etc.). There are no further checks on the format of id. Therefore, the only exception declared, NumberFormatException, is not avoided.
answer: NumberFormatException is NOT avoided because although null is checked, the string may still be malformed.
remark: NumberFormatException will be thrown if id is not null but does not contain a parseable integer, such as when id contains letters, special characters, or is an empty string, or if the integer value is out of the int range.
